origin.description: Set the value of a txtProgressBar and return the previous value.
origin.usage: setTxtProgressBar(pb, value, title = NULL, label = NULL)

arguments.name: value
arguments.text: The new value. NA and out-of-range values are ignored.

origin.details: The return value is the value from before this call.

translation.description: Update a text progress bar and return the previous value.

arguments.name: value
arguments.text: The new value. Non-finite and out-of-range values are ignored.

translation.details: title and label are accepted and ignored, as in R.
translation.example:
from utils import setTxtProgressBar, txtProgressBar
import io
bar = txtProgressBar(min=0, max=10, style=1, file=io.StringIO())
print(setTxtProgressBar(bar, 4))
